title: What If North Korea Ruled The World?
description:
What if North Korea ruled the whole world? A quick look at the numbers. North Korea has about 26 million people and the world about 8.3 billion, so each North Korean would have to govern about 320 people. Its army has about 1.28 million active soldiers (the fourth largest in the world), one for every 6,500 people on Earth. It is believed to have around 50 nuclear weapons (estimates range from about 35 to 65), the smallest stockpile of any nuclear-armed country, or one for every 166 million people.

Sources: Wikipedia, 'North Korea', 'Korean People's Army', 'North Korea and weapons of mass destruction', 'World population'. All figures are estimates; ratios are calculated by us. This is a numbers-only thought experiment; it makes no claim about any person or about the North Korean people.

What other 'what if' should we do the math on? Tell us in the comments.
